description:
Overview

We are seeking a full-time Test Software Engineer 1 - Aviation at Garmin's U.S. headquarters in the Greater Kansas City area. In this role, you will be responsible for building upon existing testing frameworks and methodologies to develop basic tests for Garmin products.

Essential Functions

Develops test software in C, C++, TestStand, or other selected languages in accordance with Garmin’s software development methodology to test the performance and functionality of Garmin’s communication and navigation products
Troubleshoots basic testing problems, correctly identifies root cause of failures, works with project team to resolve issues
Uses test development tools and equipment (in-house and commercial) to test appliances
Consistently follows Test Development Standard and project test procedure definitions
May be responsible for planning own technical work
Applies design standards and procedures using appropriate engineering tools to document and implement basic designs in an organized manner

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Math, Physics or related field OR an equivalent combination of education and experience
Excellent academics (cumulative GPA greater than or equal to 3.0 as a general rule)
Experience and/or training in high level computer languages such as C/C++ and scripting languages relevant to Garmin’s business needs
Demonstrates knowledge, education, experience and/or training necessary to develop tests and troubleshoot basic testing problems

Desired Qualifications

Outstanding academics (cumulative GPA greater than or equal to 3.5)
Relevant experience in TestStand
Relevant experience with GPIB / SCPI / IEEE interfaces with test equipment

 

Garmin International is an equal opportunity employer.  Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.

 

This position is eligible for Garmin's benefit program. Details can be found here: Garmin Benefits
